function.name: enrich_condition
function.description: Break a single condition down into its nested clause/subcondition structure.

clauses.description: The main, outermost clause(s)/paragraph(s) of the condition. Empty array if the condition has no sub-structure.

clause_identifier.description: The number, letter, or other identifier of the clause (e.g., '1)', '1 a)', 'i'). Write it exactly as it appears in the text including brackets. If none, leave blank. Typically blank for the outermost clause.

clause_text.description: The text of the clause before any subconditions.

subcondition_identifier.description: The identifier (e.g., '1)', 'a)', 'i.'). Write exactly as in text.

subcondition_text.description: The text of the subcondition. Word for word, including trailing punctuation (and, or, ;, etc.).

subcondition_identifier.description: The identifier of the nested subcondition.

subcondition_text.description: The text of the nested subcondition. Word for word.
